test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two places A and B are 60 km apart from each other on a highway. A car starts from A and another car from B at the same time. If they move in the same direction, they meet each other in 6 hours, If they move in the opposite direction towards each other, they meet in 1 hour 30 minutes. Find the speeds of the cars (in km/h).
solution:
**Formula Used:**

When moving in the same direction, relative speed = |v₁ - v₂|

When moving in the opposite direction, relative speed = v₁ + v₂

Where v₁ and v₂ are the speeds of the two cars.

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the car starting from A be v₁ km/h and the speed of the car starting from B be v₂ km/h.

**1. When moving in the same direction:**

⇒ Distance = Relative speed × Time

⇒ 60 km = |v₁ - v₂| × 6 hours

⇒ |v₁ - v₂| = 60 km / 6 hours

⇒ |v₁ - v₂| = 10 km/h ...(1)

**2. When moving in opposite directions:**

⇒ Distance = Relative speed × Time

⇒ 60 km = (v₁ + v₂) × 1.5 hours

⇒ v₁ + v₂ = 60 km / 1.5 hours

⇒ v₁ + v₂ = 40 km/h ...(2)

From equations (1) and (2):

⇒ v₁ - v₂ = 10 km/h ...(3)

⇒ v₁ + v₂ = 40 km/h ...(4)

Adding equations (3) and (4):

⇒ 2v₁ = 50 km/h

⇒ v₁ = 25 km/h

Substituting v₁ = 25 km/h into equation (4):

⇒ 25 + v₂ = 40

⇒ v₂ = 15 km/h

**∴ The speeds of the cars are 25 km/h and 15 km/h.**
